reports.headline: Gunshots at the Old Lodge
reports.body: Gunshots have been heard after sunset around the old hunting lodge {landmark}. Nobody has lived there since the hunter who built it went missing, and his rifle was never found. {name} went up to see who was shooting and found the lodge empty and the door open. Shots were heard again the next night, closer to the trees.

reports.headline: Someone Is Still Hunting Up There
reports.body: Woodcutters say that {landmark}, at dusk, they keep hearing a rifle from the direction of the old hunting lodge, though the place has stood empty for years. {name} says the shots come in pairs, and that nothing ever comes out of the trees afterwards. Families are asked to keep children away from the lodge after dark.
